title: auth-login Feature Generator
description: Adds sign-in at the authorization server of a FHIR server to the integrated frontend of an existing HAPI FHIR server

project.description: Name of the Nx server project to add the feature to

viteHttps.description: Serve the Vite dev server of each integrated frontend over https. With no value, the generator uses false when the host of app.auth.issuer is localhost, and true in all other cases.

composeHttps.description: Write docker-compose.https.yml with the server behind an https proxy. With no value, the generator uses false when the host of app.auth.issuer is localhost, and true in all other cases.
